Behind the lens

I'm Enoch Oluwatimileyin, fondly referred to as Flamingenoch. I'm a Visual Storyteller who creates stories from the half-second most people miss: a hand lifted mid-worship, a laugh before the flash, light spilling across a crowd.

Slow shutters, bold colour, quiet black and white. I mix them until the photograph feels the way the moment sounded. From stage lights to studio backdrops, every frame is built to carry a story.
